summary: Teacher QR Feature - ALL TESTS PASSED (8/8 backend, 7/7 frontend). Teachers now have QR codes generated automatically like students. Migration ran successfully (51 existing teachers got QR tokens). The QR scanner accepts both student_qr and teacher_qr types. Frontend shows 'Ver QR' option in teacher 3-dot menu, opens modal with title 'Código QR del Profesor', displays school name, photo, 'PROFESOR' label, teacher name, QR code, and Download/Print buttons. Modal closes correctly with X button.
passed_tests: POST /api/attendance/qr/generate generates QR tokens for both students AND teachers
Teacher QR tokens exist in DB for all teachers (migration ran on startup)
Teachers returned by GET /api/users include qr_token field
POST /api/attendance/qr/scan accepts teacher_qr type QR tokens and registers attendance
QR scan correctly rejects invalid QR types with QR_WRONG_TYPE error
New teacher creation automatically generates qr_token with type=teacher_qr
Teacher QR token payload contains teacher_id, school_id, type=teacher_qr
Student QR has type=student_qr with student_id, teacher QR has type=teacher_qr with teacher_id
Frontend: Teachers page shows 'Ver QR' option in 3-dot dropdown menu
Frontend: Clicking 'Ver QR' opens modal with data-testid='teacher-qr-modal'
Frontend: Modal title shows 'Código QR del Profesor'
Frontend: TeacherQRCard component renders with data-testid='teacher-qr-card'
Frontend: School name displayed in QR card header
Frontend: Teacher photo/initials displayed
Frontend: 'PROFESOR' label visible on QR card
Frontend: Teacher full name displayed correctly
Frontend: QR code rendered (using qrcode.react QRCodeSVG)
Frontend: Descargar (Download) button visible with data-testid='teacher-qr-download'
Frontend: Imprimir (Print) button visible with data-testid='teacher-qr-print'
Frontend: X close button works with data-testid='teacher-qr-modal-close'
critical_code_review_comments: server.py create_user() correctly generates qr_token for teachers with type='teacher_qr'
server.py startup migration (on_event('startup')) generates QR tokens for all existing teachers without one
server.py scan_qr_attendance() correctly handles both student_qr and teacher_qr types
TeacherQRCard.jsx component properly handles teachers with/without qr_token
UsersPage.jsx correctly shows 'Ver QR' option only for teachers (selectedRole === 'teacher')
All data-testids implemented: teacher-qr-modal, teacher-qr-modal-close, teacher-qr-card, teacher-qr-download, teacher-qr-print, show-teacher-qr-{id}
seed_data_creation: None - used existing 51 teachers with auto-migrated QR tokens
context_for_next_testing_agent: Teacher QR feature fully implemented and tested. All teachers (11 in elroble school) have QR tokens with type=teacher_qr. The QR scanner at /api/attendance/qr/scan accepts both student_qr and teacher_qr types. Frontend UsersPage shows 'Ver QR' in teacher dropdown menu, opens TeacherQRCard in modal.
